name: Creatify
description_en:
Creatify is a product in the AI video category. Its directory profile covers Multi-language Support, Customization, Video Editing, AI Assistant, Mobile Advertising, Video, Marketing ROI Analytics.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Individuals. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $13.50. Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: use supported language options in relevant workflows; adapt fields, views or workflows to a specific process; use model-assisted interactions within the product workflow. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
